missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Царь' is the masculine nominative subject of 'живёт'. 'В большом дворце' uses the prepositional to show location.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Царя' is animate masculine, so the accusative equals the genitive. 'Своего' agrees in the animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Царя' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express absence. 'В стране' is prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Царю' is the dative governed by 'поклонились', which takes a dative complement. 'Молодому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental complement. 'Царём' is the instrumental required by 'гордились'. 'Своим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О царе' uses the prepositional after 'о' for the topic. 'В книге' shows where it is written.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. After 'три' the noun takes the genitive singular 'царя'. 'В сказке' is prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Цари' is the nominative plural subject of 'правили'. 'Страной' is the instrumental governed by 'править'.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Царей' is animate, so the accusative plural equals the genitive plural. 'Великих' agrees in the animate accusative plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Царь' is nominative as the predicate noun after 'был'. 'Мудрый' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
